key: SOLARIS: The aerial unit is in place.
en: SOLARIS: The aerial unit is in place.
ja: ソラリス: 空中部隊は配置についた。

key: SIRIUS: Now will be your moment to prove yourself, boy.
en: SIRIUS: Now will be your moment to prove yourself, boy.
ja: シリウス: さあ、お前の力を証明する時が来たぞ、坊主。

key: FERN: Please.
en: FERN: Please.
ja: ファーン: はっ。

key: I don't need to prove anything.
en: I don't need to prove anything.
ja: 俺は何も証明する必要なんてない。

key: And don't call me "boy".
en: And don't call me "boy".
ja: それと、「坊主」って呼ぶな。

key: The name's Fern.
en: The name's Fern.
ja: 俺の名前はファーンだ。

key: Remember it.
en: Remember it.
ja: 覚えとけ。

key: BLAKE: We'll remember it after you do something worth remembering, little bro.
en: BLAKE: We'll remember it after you do something worth remembering, little bro.
ja: ブレイク: 覚える価値のあることでもしてから言えよな、弟。

key: FERN: Guess that means we should forget you after what happened in Ametrine.
en: FERN: Guess that means we should forget you after what happened in Ametrine.
ja: ファーン: じゃあ、アメトリンでのお前のあの失態は、忘れてやるべきってことだな。

key: BLAKE: Hah!
en: BLAKE: Hah!
ja: ブレイク: はっ!

key: Nevermind, I like this kid.
en: Nevermind, I like this kid.
ja: やっぱ、こいつ気に入った。

key: FERN: Damn right, you do.
en: FERN: Damn right, you do.
ja: ファーン: 当然だろ。

key: SOLARIS: Enough.
en: SOLARIS: Enough.
ja: ソラリス: もうよい。

key: Our objective is to recover the Sapphire Bracelets and withdraw at once.
en: Our objective is to recover the Sapphire Bracelets and withdraw at once.
ja: 我々の目的はサファイアのブレスレットの回収、そして即座の撤退だ。

key: Stop at nothing to achieve our goal.
en: Stop at nothing to achieve our goal.
ja: 目的の達成のためなら、手段を選ぶな。

key: Is this clear?
en: Is this clear?
ja: 分かったな?

key: BLAKE: Yeah, yeah, once again we're cleaning up your son's problems.
en: BLAKE: Yeah, yeah, once again we're cleaning up your son's problems.
ja: ブレイク: はいはい、また息子さんの尻拭いってわけだ。

key: SOLARIS: You are not permitted to speak ill of him as such.
en: SOLARIS: You are not permitted to speak ill of him as such.
ja: ソラリス: 彼をそのように悪く言うことは許さん。

key: His incompetence is my business, and no one else's.
en: His incompetence is my business, and no one else's.
ja: 彼の無能さは私の問題であり、他の誰にも関係ない。

key: For now, we move.
en: For now, we move.
ja: 今は行動する。

key: For the purification of our world.
en: For the purification of our world.
ja: 我らの世界の浄化のために。

key: SIRIUS: For the creation of a new one.
en: SIRIUS: For the creation of a new one.
ja: シリウス: 新たな世界の創造のためにな。

key: Old fool.
en: Old fool.
ja: 老いぼれめ。

key: BLAKE: I dunno how you stand that guy, fam.
en: BLAKE: I dunno how you stand that guy, fam.
ja: ブレイク: よくあんな奴と一緒にいられるよな、なあ。

key: I've seen rocks with more personality.
en: I've seen rocks with more personality.
ja: 石ころのほうがまだ個性あるぜ。

key: SIRIUS: It's no matter.
en: SIRIUS: It's no matter.
ja: シリウス: どうでもいい。

key: Let's move.
en: Let's move.
ja: 行くぞ。

key: The sign is scratched out.
en: The sign is scratched out.
ja: 看板は削り取られている。

key: Below it, something is scrawled:
en: Below it, something is scrawled:
ja: その下に、何か走り書きがある。

key: "Amy and Tania's House! Welcome! <3"
en: "Amy and Tania's House! Welcome! <3"
ja: 「エイミーとターニャの家! ようこそ! <3」

key: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 21!
en: \PN obtained Field Effect Read-Out 21!
ja: \PNはフィールド効果データ21を手に入れた!

key: Info on Water Surface now available!
en: Info on Water Surface now available!
ja: 水面フィールドの情報が見られるようになった!

key: AMARIA: Come here to lie to my face some more?
en: AMARIA: Come here to lie to my face some more?
ja: アマリア: またうそを並べに来たの?

key: TITANIA: What do you even want me to say here?
en: TITANIA: What do you even want me to say here?
ja: ティタニア: じゃあ、何て言えばいいの?

key: AMARIA: I want you to tell me the truth!
en: AMARIA: I want you to tell me the truth!
ja: アマリア: 本当のことを話してほしいのよ!

key: TITANIA: What "truth"?
en: TITANIA: What "truth"?
ja: ティタニア: 「本当のこと」って何?

key: I don't know what it is you're expecting to hear.
en: I don't know what it is you're expecting to hear.
ja: あなたが何を聞きたいのか、わたしには分からない。

key: AMARIA: Why don't we start with "Titawin"?
en: AMARIA: Why don't we start with "Titawin"?
ja: アマリア: じゃあ「ティタウィン」から始めましょうか?

key: TITANIA: I have no idea what that even is.
en: TITANIA: I have no idea what that even is.
ja: ティタニア: それが何なのか、まったく分からないわ。

key: AMARIA: I bet.
en: AMARIA: I bet.
ja: アマリア: どうだか。

key: \PN knows what I'm getting at.
en: \PN knows what I'm getting at.
ja: \PNなら、わたしの言いたいこと分かるでしょ。

key: TITANIA: Literally, what are you talking about?
en: TITANIA: Literally, what are you talking about?
ja: ティタニア: 本当に、何の話をしてるの?

key: You're being ridiculous.
en: You're being ridiculous.
ja: 馬鹿げてるわ。

key: AMARIA: \PN, you know she's in the wrong here, don't you?!
en: AMARIA: \PN, you know she's in the wrong here, don't you?!
ja: アマリア: \PN、この子が間違ってるって、あなたも分かるでしょ?!

key: AMARIA: See?!
en: AMARIA: See?!
ja: アマリア: ほら見なさい!

key: You can lie all you want, but we both know all about your betrayal.
en: You can lie all you want, but we both know all about your betrayal.
ja: いくらうそをついたって、あなたの裏切りのことは、わたしたち二人ともよく分かってるのよ。

key: TITANIA: What are you hoping to accomplish by dragging a third party into this?
en: TITANIA: What are you hoping to accomplish by dragging a third party into this?
ja: ティタニア: 部外者を巻き込んで、一体何をしたいの?

key: AMARIA: I'm trying to hold you accountable for this betrayal.
en: AMARIA: I'm trying to hold you accountable for this betrayal.
ja: アマリア: あなたにこの裏切りの責任を取らせようとしてるのよ。

key: TITANIA: What "betrayal"?
en: TITANIA: What "betrayal"?
ja: ティタニア: 「裏切り」って何のこと?

key: AMARIA: We know you're working with Team Meteor.
en: AMARIA: We know you're working with Team Meteor.
ja: アマリア: あなたがチームメテオと組んでるのは分かってるのよ。

key: TITANIA: ...Okay, there's been a misunderstanding.
en: TITANIA: ...Okay, there's been a misunderstanding.
ja: ティタニア: ……分かった、誤解があるみたいね。

key: I've been giving them false information to keep them from finding you.
en: I've been giving them false information to keep them from finding you.
ja: あなたを見つけさせないために、彼らに偽の情報を流し続けてきたの。

key: If that's what this is all about, we can all relax and go home.
en: If that's what this is all about, we can all relax and go home.
ja: それが理由だっていうなら、みんな安心して帰れるわね。

key: AMARIA: Then why all the secrecy?!
en: AMARIA: Then why all the secrecy?!
ja: アマリア: じゃあ、どうしてそんなに隠し事ばかりするの?!

key: Why all the comments about lying--
en: Why all the comments about lying--
ja: うそについての態度も、

key: The defensiveness, the cold silence--
en: The defensiveness, the cold silence--
ja: 身構えるところも、冷たい沈黙も――

key: I love you so much, and I would accept anything you ever shared with me--
en: I love you so much, and I would accept anything you ever shared with me--
ja: わたしはあなたをこんなに愛してるのに、あなたが打ち明けてくれることなら何だって受け止めるつもりだったのに――

key: So why don't you!?
en: So why don't you!?
ja: なのに、どうして話してくれないの!?

key: AMARIA: ...Because you don't love me.
en: AMARIA: ...Because you don't love me.
ja: アマリア: ……あなたがわたしを愛していないからでしょ。

key: TITANIA: It's not that simple--
en: TITANIA: It's not that simple--
ja: ティタニア: そんな単純な話じゃ――

key: AMARIA: You don't love me the way I love you.
en: AMARIA: You don't love me the way I love you.
ja: アマリア: あなたは、わたしがあなたを愛するようには、わたしを愛していない。

key: Tell me I'm wrong.
en: Tell me I'm wrong.
ja: 違うって言ってよ。

key: AMARIA: That's what I thought.
en: AMARIA: That's what I thought.
ja: アマリア: やっぱりね。

key: TITANIA: I care about you more than anyone else in the entire world.
en: TITANIA: I care about you more than anyone else in the entire world.
ja: ティタニア: 世界中の誰よりも、あなたのことを大切に思ってる。

key: AMARIA: But you don't love me.
en: AMARIA: But you don't love me.
ja: アマリア: でも、わたしを愛してはいない。

key: You were only pretending to.
en: You were only pretending to.
ja: ずっと、愛してるふりをしてただけ。

key: TITANIA: I couldn't stand the thought of you doing something--
en: TITANIA: I couldn't stand the thought of you doing something--
ja: ティタニア: あなたが何かしてしまうんじゃないかって、耐えられなかったの――

key: Of you hurting yourself,
en: Of you hurting yourself,
ja: 自分を傷つけてしまうんじゃないかって、

key: Just because I wasn't able to return your feelings properly.
en: Just because I wasn't able to return your feelings properly.
ja: わたしがあなたの気持ちにきちんと応えられなかったせいで。

key: If I had a choice, I would, in a heartbeat.
en: If I had a choice, I would, in a heartbeat.
ja: 選べるものなら、迷わずそうしてた。

key: At the time-- when it first became official-- I thought,
en: At the time-- when it first became official-- I thought,
ja: あの時――正式に付き合い始めた時――わたしは思ったの、

key: I shouldn't let my own lack of emotions get in the way of your happiness.
en: I shouldn't let my own lack of emotions get in the way of your happiness.
ja: 自分の感情の欠如で、あなたの幸せを邪魔しちゃいけないって。

key: I thought, if I stuck with you, and really devoted myself to you,
en: I thought, if I stuck with you, and really devoted myself to you,
ja: あなたのそばにいて、本当に尽くし続ければ、

key: Maybe you'd get better,
en: Maybe you'd get better,
ja: あなたはもっと良くなるかもしれない、

key: Or maybe I would start to feel it properly.
en: Or maybe I would start to feel it properly.
ja: それか、わたし自身がちゃんと感じられるようになるかもしれないって、そう思ってた。

key: I just had to keep things stable until then.
en: I just had to keep things stable until then.
ja: それまでは、ただ物事を安定させておかなきゃって。

key: AMARIA: And I see that worked out great.
en: AMARIA: And I see that worked out great.
ja: アマリア: それがうまくいったみたいで何よりね。

key: TITANIA: I wish it had.
en: TITANIA: I wish it had.
ja: ティタニア: そうであってほしかった。

key: I'm sorry.
en: I'm sorry.
ja: ごめんなさい。

key: AMARIA: I don't want you to apologize for your feelings, or lack thereof.
en: AMARIA: I don't want you to apologize for your feelings, or lack thereof.
ja: アマリア: あなたの気持ちのこと、それがないことについて、謝ってほしいわけじゃない。

key: I want you to apologize for lying.
en: I want you to apologize for lying.
ja: うそをついたことを謝ってほしいの。

key: For years-- for all that is holy-- lying all of this time?
en: For years-- for all that is holy-- lying all of this time?
ja: 何年も――一体全体――ずっとうそをついてたの?

key: How many times have we kissed?
en: How many times have we kissed?
ja: わたしたち、何回キスした?

key: How many times were you doing that just for my sake?
en: How many times were you doing that just for my sake?
ja: そのうち何回が、わたしのためだけにしてたことなの?

key: TITANIA: ...I don't think you want me to answer that.
en: TITANIA: ...I don't think you want me to answer that.
ja: ティタニア: ……それに答えてほしいとは、思ってないでしょ。

key: AMARIA: Right.
en: AMARIA: Right.
ja: アマリア: そうね。

key: I bet.
en: I bet.
ja: どうせそうよ。

key: And you assured me otherwise how many times?
en: And you assured me otherwise how many times?
ja: それで、あなたは何回わたしに違うって言い聞かせてきたの?

key: All just out of what, pity?
en: All just out of what, pity?
ja: 全部、何、あわれみから?

key: TITANIA: Not pity.
en: TITANIA: Not pity.
ja: ティタニア: あわれみじゃない。

key: I thought it was compassion--
en: I thought it was compassion--
ja: 思いやりだと思ってた――

key: But I know it was misguided.
en: But I know it was misguided.
ja: でも、それが見当違いだったのは分かってる。

key: AMARIA: You were my world.
en: AMARIA: You were my world.
ja: アマリア: あなたはわたしのすべてだった。

key: I guess I was just your prison.
en: I guess I was just your prison.
ja: わたしはただ、あなたの独房だったってわけね。

key: AMARIA: Well, it's okay.
en: AMARIA: Well, it's okay.
ja: アマリア: まあ、いいわ。

key: I can set you free now.
en: I can set you free now.
ja: 今、あなたを自由にしてあげる。

key: TITANIA: I didn't want you to do something stupid just because of me--
en: TITANIA: I didn't want you to do something stupid just because of me--
ja: ティタニア: わたしのせいで、あなたに馬鹿な真似をしてほしくなかったの――

key: Just because I'm cold-hearted, and made a mistake, and the cost sunk more every day.
en: Just because I'm cold-hearted, and made a mistake, and the cost sunk more every day.
ja: わたしが冷たくて、間違いを犯して、その代償が日に日に膨らんでいっただけなのに。

key: What was I supposed to do?
en: What was I supposed to do?
ja: わたしはどうすればよかったの?

key: I thought if I told you, or even if I just rejected you in the first place--
en: I thought if I told you, or even if I just rejected you in the first place--
ja: 話していたら、それか最初から突き放していたら――

key: That you would go over the deep end, and--
en: That you would go over the deep end, and--
ja: あなたが取り返しのつかないことをして、それで――

key: AMARIA: Well,
en: AMARIA: Well,
ja: アマリア: そう、

key: Maybe you were right.
en: Maybe you were right.
ja: あなたの言う通りだったのかもね。

key: TITANIA: Amy, wait--
en: TITANIA: Amy, wait--
ja: ティタニア: エイミー、待って――

key: TITANIA: \PN,
en: TITANIA: \PN,
ja: ティタニア: \PN、

key: I'm going after her, but I don't have a way back up.
en: I'm going after her, but I don't have a way back up.
ja: 彼女を追いかけるけど、こっちに戻ってくる手段がないの。

key: Figure it out.
en: Figure it out.
ja: なんとかして。
\PNっ!!!

key: JULIA: Hi, how are you, it's totally been like fourteen episodes since I saw you last!
en: JULIA: Hi, how are you, it's totally been like fourteen episodes since I saw you last!
ja: ジュリア: やっほー元気? 会うのなんてマジで14話ぶりくらいじゃない!

key: How have you been!?
en: How have you been!?
ja: 最近どうしてた!?

key: FLORINIA: Greetings.
en: FLORINIA: Greetings.
ja: フロリニア: ご機嫌よう。

key: JULIA: We originally flew up here cuz we saw Amy and Tania riding up the waterfall and we were filled with big question marks--
en: JULIA: We originally flew up here cuz we saw Amy and Tania riding up the waterfall and we were filled with big question marks--
ja: ジュリア: もともとはさ、エイミーとターニャが滝を登ってくの見て、頭の中はてなマークだらけになってここまで飛んできたわけよ――

key: But seeing you too is like a giant exclamation point so we HAD to come up!
en: But seeing you too is like a giant exclamation point so we HAD to come up!
ja: でもあんたまでいるのを見たら、もうびっくりマーク大爆発だから、来ないわけにいかなかったの!

key: I'm really impressed you've made it this far to challenge our sisters cuz like--
en: I'm really impressed you've made it this far to challenge our sisters cuz like--
ja: うちの姉妹たちに挑めるとこまで来てるの、正直すごいと思うよ、だってさ――

key: Almost nobody even GETS to challenge some of the higher up Leaders cuz so many of the other ones are off hiding in caves or getting chased by evil doctors!
en: Almost nobody even GETS to challenge some of the higher up Leaders cuz so many of the other ones are off hiding in caves or getting chased by evil doctors!
ja: 上位のリーダーに挑めるとこまで来る人なんて、ほとんどいないんだから! だって他のリーダーたち、洞窟に隠れてたり悪の博士に追いかけられてたりばっかりでさ!

key: Like how is anybody SUPPOSED to handle challenging people like that in the first place?
en: Like how is anybody SUPPOSED to handle challenging people like that in the first place?
ja: そもそもそんな人たちに、どうやって挑めっていうのよ?

key: I'm lucky that I'm the first one for most new Trainers!
en: I'm lucky that I'm the first one for most new Trainers!
ja: あたしはたいていの新人トレーナーにとって最初のリーダーだから、ラッキーってわけ!

key: FLORINIA: Indeed.
en: FLORINIA: Indeed.
ja: フロリニア: 確かに。

key: Although distant, Ame has been overseeing your endeavors, and will be modifying procedures and policies as necessary.
en: Although distant, Ame has been overseeing your endeavors, and will be modifying procedures and policies as necessary.
ja: 遠くからではありますが、アメはあなたの活動を見守っており、必要に応じて手順や方針を調整していきます。

key: She has additionally permitted us to deliver this to you.
en: She has additionally permitted us to deliver this to you.
ja: また、これをあなたにお渡しするよう、彼女から許可を得ています。

key: JULIA: You're super gonna need a badgeythingy for that, buuuut I think you can get it from beating Seel.
en: JULIA: You're super gonna need a badgeythingy for that, buuuut I think you can get it from beating Seel.
ja: ジュリア: それにはバッジ的なやつが超必要になるんだけどぉ、パウワウを倒せば手に入ると思うよ。

key: FLORINIA: Ciel.
en: FLORINIA: Ciel.
ja: フロリニア: シエルです。

key: JULIA: Riniiii, that's what I said!
en: JULIA: Riniiii, that's what I said!
ja: ジュリア: リニりん、それあたしも言ったじゃん!

key: Just go beat up wild Seel until one drops a Badge!
en: Just go beat up wild Seel until one drops a Badge!
ja: とにかく野生のパウワウを倒しまくってればバッジが手に入るから!

key: Anyyyywayyy, once you have that, you can come back to the city and say "Hi" sometime!
en: Anyyyywayyy, once you have that, you can come back to the city and say "Hi" sometime!
ja: とにかくさぁ、それが手に入ったら、いつか街に戻ってきて「やっほー」って言いに来てよね!

key: You should SEE what we've done to the place!
en: You should SEE what we've done to the place!
ja: あたしたちがあの街をどうしたか、絶対見てほしいんだから!

key: That old Fairy Gym Leader showed up and was able to rally everyone into helping renovate the city and it's practically EXPLODED with progress!
en: That old Fairy Gym Leader showed up and was able to rally everyone into helping renovate the city and it's practically EXPLODED with progress!
ja: あのフェアリータイプの元リーダーが現れてさ、みんなを街の改修に集めてくれて、もうマジで爆発的に進んでるの!

key: FLORINIA: While several explosions were indeed involved, they were not an intended reconstructional step.
en: FLORINIA: While several explosions were indeed involved, they were not an intended reconstructional step.
ja: フロリニア: 実際にいくつか爆発は起きましたが、それは意図された復興工程ではありません。

key: JULIA: Theywereme.
en: JULIA: Theywereme.
ja: ジュリア: あれあたしだから。

key: Oops?
en: Oops?
ja: てへ?

key: But that's not important, because most of the people survived, probably!
en: But that's not important, because most of the people survived, probably!
ja: でもそんなの重要じゃないって、だってほとんどの人、たぶん生き延びてるし!

key: FLORINIA: ...Pause.
en: FLORINIA: ...Pause.
ja: フロリニア: ……待って。

key: JULIA: Huh?
en: JULIA: Huh?
ja: ジュリア: え?

key: What are we pausing for?
en: What are we pausing for?
ja: 何のために止まるの?

key: Is it a commercial break?
en: Is it a commercial break?
ja: コマーシャルタイム?

key: FLORINIA: Helicopter detected.
en: FLORINIA: Helicopter detected.
ja: フロリニア: ヘリコプターを検知。

key: Team Meteor confirmed.
en: Team Meteor confirmed.
ja: チームメテオと確認。

key: JULIA: Whaaaat, they're here, too?
en: JULIA: Whaaaat, they're here, too?
ja: ジュリア: ええーっ、こんなとこにまで来てるの?

key: No way!
en: No way!
ja: うそでしょ!

key: I'm gonna boomboom their faces off if they try and do anything to Amy and Tania!
en: I'm gonna boomboom their faces off if they try and do anything to Amy and Tania!
ja: エイミーとターニャに何かしようもんなら、あいつらの顔面ドッカンしてやるんだから!

key: FLORINIA: This ordeal may not be easily resolved.
en: FLORINIA: This ordeal may not be easily resolved.
ja: フロリニア: この試練は容易には解決しないかもしれません。

key: Do ensure your preparation before attending to it.
en: Do ensure your preparation before attending to it.
ja: 対応する前に、しっかり準備を整えてください。

key: TITANIA: I'm so fucking tired of this.
en: TITANIA: I'm so fucking tired of this.
ja: ティタニア: もう本当にうんざりなの。

key: You know, it's one thing that she found out about my facade and tried to off herself.
en: You know, it's one thing that she found out about my facade and tried to off herself.
ja: 彼女がわたしの見せかけに気づいて、自殺しようとしたのは、まだひとつの出来事として理解できる。

key: But I was actually glad to have that shackle lifted off of me.
en: But I was actually glad to have that shackle lifted off of me.
ja: でも正直、その足かせが外れて、わたしはほっとしてしまってた。

key: And now, everything that we just went through has been completely voided by her losing her memory.
en: And now, everything that we just went through has been completely voided by her losing her memory.
ja: それなのに今、さっき二人で乗り越えたばかりのことが、彼女の記憶喪失で全部なかったことになってしまった。

key: And I'm stuck again.
en: And I'm stuck again.
ja: また元に戻ってしまったの。

key: TITANIA: Ugh...
en: TITANIA: Ugh...
ja: ティタニア: うぅ……

key: I can't keep living this lie, but I'm not about to let her kill herself twice.
en: I can't keep living this lie, but I'm not about to let her kill herself twice.
ja: このうそを生き続けるなんてもうできない、でも彼女を二度も自殺させるわけにはいかない。

key: TITANIA: I'll figure something out.
en: TITANIA: I'll figure something out.
ja: ティタニア: 何とかするわ。

key: In the meantime, I'm leaving.
en: In the meantime, I'm leaving.
ja: とりあえず、わたしはここを離れる。

key: I'm taking the Bracelets as far away from here as I can.
en: I'm taking the Bracelets as far away from here as I can.
ja: ブレスレットは、できる限り遠くへ持っていくつもり。

key: If Meteor wants them, they'll have to come and get them.
en: If Meteor wants them, they'll have to come and get them.
ja: メテオが欲しいなら、自分たちで取りに来ることね。

key: And believe me, they'll regret it if they try.
en: And believe me, they'll regret it if they try.
ja: でも言っておくけど、そんなことすれば後悔するわよ。

key: TITANIA: Skarmory, let's go!
en: TITANIA: Skarmory, let's go!
ja: ティタニア: エアームド、行くわよ!

key: TITANIA: So that's how it is.
en: TITANIA: So that's how it is.
ja: ティタニア: そういうことなのね。

key: I finally said what I needed to.
en: I finally said what I needed to.
ja: やっと言うべきことを言えた。

key: And it only took that boy dying.
en: And it only took that boy dying.
ja: あの子が死ぬだけで済んだんだから。

key: Maybe she kills herself.
en: Maybe she kills herself.
ja: 彼女は自殺するかもしれない。

key: I couldn't stop her anyway.
en: I couldn't stop her anyway.
ja: どのみち止められなかったでしょうし。

key: Maybe Lin comes here after all.
en: Maybe Lin comes here after all.
ja: 結局、リンがここに来るかもしれない。

key: I guess that's up to you.
en: I guess that's up to you.
ja: それはあなた次第ってことね。

key: I'm washing my hands of her.
en: I'm washing my hands of her.
ja: 彼女とは手を切るわ。

key: After that stunt, there's no point in playing make- believe anymore.
en: After that stunt, there's no point in playing make- believe anymore.
ja: あんな真似をされた後じゃ、もうお芝居を続ける意味もない。

key: And there's no point in staying here.
en: And there's no point in staying here.
ja: ここに留まる意味もない。

key: I'll see you again, \PN.
en: I'll see you again, \PN.
ja: また会いましょう、\PN。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
